Q: How do I optimize my C++ Rubik’s Cube Solver code? A:

Do NOT link to code outside of the question! Links can be considered malicious and disappear after a while. As for your problem, 1. Make sure you have the right algorithm (almost always the most important). 2. Measure! Find out where your bottlenecks are (e.g. profile, benchmark). Make sure you know how to avoid copying unecessary data as well, maybe you just forgot to pass data by reference somewhere... All in all your question is just unclear

Q: WTelegramClient: Intermittent Auth_SentCode success — code arrives "via App" but is missing after periods of inactivity A:

It's likely Telegram server blocking login abuse (too many login attempts from this IP recently?)

In any case, it's not a problem with the WTelegramClient library
